messages:
maria g: Following up on Peregrine postmortem action items. Root cause summary: flapping VPC peer + controller race -> stale route entries. Need clear owners, dates, and a verification plan.

alex m: Thanks. We should split work into (A) controller fixes (B) network config/firmware (C) canary + monitoring. Who takes what?

sanjay r: I'll take controller fixes. Plan: reproduce in chaos-staging, add a per-peer debounce and strict KV sync lock, add unit+e2e. Tentative ETA: PR by 2026-03-04, tests by 2026-03-06.

maria g: I'll coordinate with the customer's network team and vendor. Ask vendor about firmware that addresses rapid reconnect handling. If maintenance window required, I'll surface options. Target initial vendor writeup by 2026-03-02.

julia ops: I'll own canary and observability. Canary plan: two non-prod tenants, mirrored peering, enable debug logs for BGP/peer-management, and run synthetic flap generator. Will also add Grafana panels for peering_errors and route_staleness. Canary start target: 2026-03-07.

infra-bot: deploy: canary-cluster-pt created at 1723460000, logging and metrics enabled.

vendor-bot: vendor: model XZ-900 firmware v1.2.8 has improved timeout/backoff controls. Enabling graceful-peering requires restart during maint window.

sanjay r: Repro notes for ticket RW-7612: trigger sequence: peer drop -> reconnect within 3s -> concurrent KV apply -> controller overwrites cleanup. Log sample: ```WARN tenant-iso: overlapping-sync detected; skipping safe-cleanup``` 
I'll attach full traces and a minimal repro script to the ticket.

alex m: Good. Also propose a short-term mitigation: skip aggressive route pruning for peers with recent restart timestamps (safelist) and emit high-severity alerts for route anomalies. Sanjay, include latency/cost tradeoffs in your PR description.

sanjay r: Will do. Creating RFC in GH: redwood/rfcs#912 (controller debounce + safelist). Estimated dev + tests: 3 workdays.

maria g: Vendor confirmed maintenance windows: three slots next week. I'll try to book the Thu slot; if customer refuses, we'll enable local backoff config that reduces reconnect frequency as fallback.

julia ops: Added a recurring dashboard job: weekly peering-flap histogram and 72h stale-route trend. Also creating an alert that fires if flap_count > 4 in 24h. If alert fires, auto-create incident and tag oncall.

alex m: Closing criteria: merged controller fix + 72h clean canary + firmware deployed or validated fallback config. Target to close actions: 2026-03-11 if all goes well.

sanjay r: Progress update: PR opened at 1723459000: PR #2891. Includes debounce logic + unit tests. Running integration in CI now.

julia ops: Canary initial run shows reduced error rate with safelist + debounce enabled. Will run 48h longer and post metrics.

maria g: Customer accepted Thu maintenance 2026-03-05 02:00 UTC. Vendor will apply v1.2.8 and enable graceful-peering flag. I'll post maintenance window details to the CS ticket.

alex m: Great work everyone. We'll reconvene after the 72h clean window. If anyone hits blockers, drop updates here and mark the action tracker. Thanks.
